methods_quotes.q: For evaluation of vaccine effectiveness, only students enrolled in the school at the beginning of the outbreak were included.
Vaccine effectiveness (VE) was calculated as VE (%) = [(ARU - ARV) / ARU] x 100
Wileaxon rank-sum test for one-sided p value used.
